name: 95843 · Antelope, CA
findings: ZIP 95843 (Antelope) has 71 nonprofit organizations. 23 of them (32%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 21 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (33% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 95843 (Antelope) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 95843 (Antelope) list public events in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 40% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 35 organizations here; 45% of all organizations here have no identified type.
